GDG on Campus Applied Science Private University - Amman, Jordan

About

The first chapter of the Google Developer Student Clubs at the Applied Science University was founded in 2020/2021 by Belal Malabeh, and Dyala Nafees is currently leading its 7th chapter. The chapter aims to create a collaborative environment where students can transform knowledge into practice, fostering peer-to-peer learning and creating solutions for the students' community.
